Man Kills Wife and Priests in UP Puja, Son Shot; Attacker Dead

In Azamgarh, Uttar Pradesh, a man killed his wife and two priests during a puja ceremony. He also shot his 10-year-old son. The man was later killed by police action after reportedly holding children hostage. The incident occurred during a religious ritual.
